When you search for a kitchen hood commercial or a kitchen hood, size is the first question: the hood must be wider than the cooking line. Next come the baffle filters, the stainless steel finish and the way air leaves the building. We help you with all three, including advice on the fan.

Looking for a commercial kitchen hood in Kenya? Talk to the team that builds it. We will explain the options, the delivery and the aftercare in plain language.

sections.heading: Ask Before You Order
sections.body: Send us your floor plan or a few measurements and we will check clearances, water and drain points and power or gas needs, so there are no surprises on delivery day.

sections.heading: Why Buy from Kitchen And All
sections.body:
Hoods must be hung safely, so we plan suspension points with you.

Fabrication you can trust. Our stainless steel work is cut, welded and polished by experienced fabricators, and each piece is checked before it leaves the workshop.

Approved for professional use. Health officers look for hygienic, easy to clean equipment, and ours meets government and public health regulations so your inspection goes smoothly.

Support before and after you buy. Our staff help you compare options, confirm sizes and installation and show you how to use and care for your equipment.

Quick delivery. Delivery is free within Nairobi, and we deliver quickly to all other parts of Kenya with shipping charges.

faqs.q: Where can I buy an exhaust canopy hood in Kenya?
faqs.a: Order it from Kitchen And All on kitchenandall.co.ke, or talk to our team for advice first. Delivery is free within Nairobi and quick to the rest of Kenya with shipping charges.

faqs.q: How much is a kitchen hood in Kenya?
faqs.a: Look at the price shown above for this exact unit. If you want a different build, the cost will change with the length and width over your cooking line, the filters, the fan and the way the duct exits the building; our team will quote you straight away.

faqs.q: Does the hood come with a fan and ducting?
faqs.a: Tell us whether you need a fan and the duct route to the outside. We will advise on what your kitchen needs.

faqs.q: How is it hung?
faqs.a: From the ceiling on strong supports. Our team will advise.

faqs.q: Can it go over an island?
faqs.a: Yes, that is its main use.

faqs.q: Do you supply fans?
faqs.a: Yes, ask us.
